integrity: Complete self-contained analytic proof and reproducible quadrature; finite numerical checks are not infinite certification. Published concavity bounds are credited as prior knowledge.
scientific_limitations: Fixed Lipschitz concave-width convex lenses only; no uniform constants over moving profiles and no unbounded tip slopes. Second-order finite part not determined. No independent historical-priority certification.
title: Universal logarithmic mean-distance law for collapsing convex lenses
